items.title: 6.10 Machine learning ke tools aur platforms (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.10 before its first sub-heading (PDF 88-88); each sub-heading has its own lesson.

blocks.text: Machine learning mein data analysis aur modeling ke liye mukhtalif tools istemal hote hain. Tools data jama, process aur analyze karne mein madad dete hain. Kuch tools saade aur naye seekhne walon (beginners) ke liye asaan hain, aur kuch advanced (aage ke) machine learning kaamon ke liye hain. Sahi tool chunna aham hai, kyunke har tool ki apni khoobiyan hain. Tools kaam ki efficiency aur accuracy barhate hain aur mazboot bunyad banate hain. Yeh platforms aaj ke data science ke kaam ko chalate hain. Machine learning ke tools aur platforms yeh hain:

items: Python aur Jupyter notebooks: machine learning ke liye
